amendments.name: Amendment a
amendments.summary: The overall rationale for the changes implemented in this protocol amendment is to address feedback received from an internal safety committee.

changes.name: Section 5.2 Exclusion Criteria
changes.summary:
Exclusion Criterion #16: removed "Exception: Short-term treatment with insulin for <14 days is allowed for certain clinical situations, such as, elective surgery, during hospitalization, hyperosmolar states, or acute illness."
Edited Exclusion Criterion #36 to remove ", except for the use of insulin for treatment of gestational diabetes or acute, temporary use of insulin (≤14 days), for example, for acute illness, hospitalization, elective surgery."
Edited Exclusion Criterion #40 to add "Note: Insulin therapy is not allowed within 90 days prior to Visit 1."

changes.name: Section 6.9.1 Initiation of new Antihyperglycemic Medications
changes.summary: Added "Insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited."

changes.name: Section 6.9.2 Rescue Therapy for Severe, Persistent Hyperglycemia
changes.summary:
Updated from "Participants should" to "Participants must" continue administering assigned study intervention, and added clarification "unless insulin is used as short-term rescue therapy."
Updated Recommended glycemic rescue therapy section to state that urgent use of short-term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting may be used as rescue therapy, and added respective instructions to temporarily interrupt study intervention.
Removed "Short-term treatment with insulin not as rescue therapy" section.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Age requirement
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participant must be at least 18 years of age and of the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction in which the study is taking place at the time of signing the informed consent.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Type 2 diabetes diagnosis
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a clinical diagnosis of T2D according to the World Health Organization (WHO) classification or other locally applicable standards for at least 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1), with HbA1c ≤10.0% (86 mmol/mol) at screening (Visit 1)

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Stable T2D treatment
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are on stable treatment for T2D for at least 90 days prior to screening (Visit 1), consisting of either diet/exercise alone or up to 3 oral AHMs (excluding incretins). Note: DPP-4i are allowed.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: BMI requirement
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a BMI >27 kg/m2 at Visit 1. Note: In participants with limb amputation or limb loss, the investigator should reach out to the Lilly medical monitor for information regarding calculation of BMI.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Stable body weight
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a stable body weight (<5% body weight change) for 90 days prior to screening at Visit 1.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: History of unsuccessful dietary effort
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a history of at least 1 self-reported unsuccessful dietary effort to reduce body weight

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Contraceptive requirements
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: IOCBP, INOCBP, and individuals AMAB who agree to abide by the reproductive and contraceptive requirements provided in Section 10.4. may participate in this trial. See Section 10.4 for definitions and additional requirements related to contraception. Note: Contraceptive use by participants should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Informed consent capability
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are capable of giving signed informed consent as described in Appendix 1, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Reliability and willingness to comply
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are reliable and willing to make themselves available for the duration of the study and attend required study visits, and are willing and able to follow study procedures as required, such as self-inject study intervention, store and take the provided study intervention as directed, maintain electronic study diary and paper log, complete the required questionnaires, and undergo DXA procedure. Note: if a person is unable to undergo the DXA due to physical limitations of the DXA machine, or because they have implants, hardware, or other foreign materials that may interfere with the scan according to the DXA manufacturer's specification, this will not be considered an exclusionary criterion.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity. Exception: The following are allowed if performed >1 year before screening (Visit 1): liposuction, cryolipolysis, or abdominoplasty.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Prior or planned endoscopic/device-based therapy for obesity
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a prior or planned endoscopic procedure and/or device-based therapy for obesity, such as, but not limited to mucosal ablation, gastric artery embolization, laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding, intragastric balloon, or duodenal-jejunal endoluminal liner. Exception: Prior device-based therapy is acceptable if device removal was more than 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Obesity induced by endocrinologic disorders or monogenetic/syndromic forms
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have obesity induced by other endocrinologic disorders, for example, Cushing Syndrome, or are diagnosed with monogenetic or syndromic forms of obesity, for example, Melanocortin 4 Receptor deficiency or Prader Willi Syndrome.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Type 1 diabetes or related conditions
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have type 1 diabetes mellitus, latent autoimmune diabetes, or history of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar coma

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Severe hypoglycemia or hypoglycemia unawareness
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have had 1 or more episode of severe hypoglycemia and/or 1 or more episode of hypoglycemia unawareness within the 180 days prior to Visit 1. Note: Any participant that the investigator feels will not be able to communicate an understanding of hypoglycemic symptoms and the appropriate treatment of hypoglycemia should also be excluded.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: High fasting glucose
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have fasting glucose >270 mg/dL (>15.0 mmol/L) confirmed by the central laboratory at screening (Visit 1).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent use of prohibited antihyperglycemic medications
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have taken within 90 days before screening (Visit 1) any of the following AHMs: amylin analogs, GLP-1 receptor agonists, GIP/GLP receptor agonists, or insulin.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Current treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are currently receiving or planning to receive treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema, for example, laser photocoagulation or intravitreal injections of antivascular endothelial growth factor inhibitors. Note: All participants will have a baseline fundus photography assessment prior to randomization (Visit 3). Qualifying fundus photographs obtained within 90 days before Visit 1 may be used for eligibility determination.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Renal impairment
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have renal impairment measured as eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2, calculated by eGFRcr-cys formula as per Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration as determined by central laboratory during screening (Visit 1).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Significant active autoimmune abnormality
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have evidence of significant, active autoimmune abnormality, for example, lupus or rheumatoid arthritis, that, in the opinion of the investigator, is likely to require concurrent treatment with systemic glucocorticoids during the course of the study.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent cardiovascular events
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have had within 90 days prior to screening (Visit 1): acute myocardial infarction, cerebrovascular accident (stroke), coronary artery revascularization, unstable angina, or hospitalization due to congestive heart failure.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: NYHA Class IV congestive heart failure
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a history or diagnosis of New York Heart Association Functional Classification Class IV congestive heart failure.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Bradycardia or AV block
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have either ongoing asymptomatic bradycardia defined as <50 beats per minute at V1, or ECG findings at V1 of 2nd degree AV block or higher, or history of symptomatic bradycardia with uncorrected etiology, including diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome. Note: Historical symptomatic bradycardia or AV nodal block due to a corrected transient etiology will not be considered exclusionary (for example, previous beta-blocker, calcium channel blocker, or other medication that can lead to AV block; or conduction disorder corrected with cardiac device).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Hepatic conditions or abnormal liver laboratory values
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have acute or chronic hepatitis, including a history of autoimmune hepatitis, signs, or symptoms of any other liver disease other than nonalcoholic fatty liver disease, or any of these laboratory values confirmed by central lab at screening (Visit 1): ALT or AST level ≥3.0x the ULN (Note: Participants with nonalcoholic fatty liver disease may participate in the study if their ALT level is <3.0x the ULN), ALP level ≥1.5x the ULN, total bilirubin level ≥1.5x the ULN, except for participants with history of Gilbert's Syndrome.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Significant uncontrolled endocrine abnormality
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have evidence of significant, uncontrolled endocrine abnormality, in the opinion of the investigator; for example, thyrotoxicosis or adrenal crisis.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Abnormal thyroid stimulating hormone levels
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have thyroid stimulating hormone levels outside the normal reference range for the central laboratory at Visit 1. Exception: Participants with hypothyroidism who are clinically euthyroid and on stable thyroid replacement therapy for at least 60 days prior to Visit 1 are acceptable exceptions to this criterion.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Family or personal history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN2
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a family or personal history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia syndrome type 2.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: History of active or untreated malignancy
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a history of an active or untreated malignancy or are in remission from a malignancy for less than 5 years (Visit 1). Exceptions: basal or squamous cell skin cancer, in situ carcinomas of the cervix, Grade 1 (for example, Gleason 6 or lower) prostate cancer.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Hematological condition interfering with HbA1c measurement
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have any hematological condition that may interfere with HbA1c measurement, for example, hemolytic anemias or sickle cell disease.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Significant active or unstable major depressive or psychiatric disorder
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a history of significant active or unstable major depressive disorder or other severe psychiatric disorder, such as schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or other serious mood or anxiety disorder, within the last 2 years, OR In the investigator's opinion, have any significant mental health disorder that may put the individual at higher risk of study participation.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: PHQ-9 score threshold
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a PHQ-9 score of 15 or more at any screening visit (Visit 1) or at randomization (Visit 3).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Significant risk for suicide
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are, in the judgment of the investigator, deemed to be at significant risk for suicide

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: C-SSRS suicidal ideation or behavior
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have answered "yes" to either Question 4 or Question 5 on the "Suicidal Ideation" portion of the C-SSRS and the ideation occurred within the past 3 months OR Have answered "yes" to any of the suicide-related behaviors (actual attempt, interrupted attempt, aborted attempt, preparatory act or behavior) on the "suicidal behavior" portion of the C-SSRS, and the behavior occurred within the past 5 years. Note: Non-suicidal self-injurious behavior is not considered a suicide-related behavior.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Clinically significant gastric emptying abnormality
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a known clinically significant gastric emptying abnormality, such as severe diabetic gastroparesis or gastric outlet obstruction, or chronically take drugs that directly affect GI motility.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Transplanted organ or awaiting organ transplant
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have had a transplanted organ or awaiting an organ transplant. Exception: Corneal transplants or keratoplasty are allowed.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Planned surgery during the study
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: At the time of screening, have a planned surgery, except for minor surgical procedures, to occur during the study.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Prohibited glucose-lowering medications or insulin history
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have taken any prohibited glucose-lowering medications (see Section 6.9.3) within 90 days of Visit 1 or have a history of insulin therapy within 90 days prior to Visit 1.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Chronic systemic glucocorticoid therapy
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are receiving or have received within 90 days prior to screening chronic (>2 weeks) systemic glucocorticoid therapy (excluding topical, intraocular, intranasal, single intraarticular injections, single localized injections of skin lesions or tendon, or inhaled preparations).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Hypersensitivity to amylin or study product
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have known or suspected hypersensitivity to amylin or study product.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent use of weight reduction medications or remedies
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have taken within 90 days prior to screening (Visit 1) prescribed or over-the-counter medications, or alternative remedies, including herbal or nutritional supplements, intended to promote body weight reduction. Examples include, but are not limited to GLP-1RA, GIP/GLP-1RA, orlistat, sibutramine, phenylpropanolamine, mazindol, phentermine, lorcaserin, phendimetrazine, phentermine/topiramate, naltrexone/bupropion, and ingested material that transiently occupies space in the stomach, for example, hydrogel capsules made of cellulose and citric acid. Exception: AHMs for the management of T2D, for example, SGLT-2 inhibitors, are permitted, with the exception of the examples listed above used as AHM (for example, GLP-1RA, GIP/GLP-1RA).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Medications that may cause significant weight gain
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are receiving or have received within 90 days of screening, medications that may cause significant weight gain – including but not limited to tricyclic antidepressants, atypical antipsychotics, and mood stabilizers – unless at a stable dose for more than 6 months, with no planned dose changes, and documented weight stability (see Appendix 8: Section 10.8). Note: Insulin therapy is not allowed within 90 days prior to Visit 1.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent subcutaneous/intramuscular or implantable/injectable contraceptives
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have started subcutaneous/intramuscular or implantable/injectable contraceptives such as Depo-Provera®, Nexplanon, within 18 months prior to screening (Visit 1). Note: Intrauterine devices are acceptable.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Currently enrolled in another clinical study
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are currently enrolled in any other clinical study involving an investigational product or any other type of medical research judged not to be scientifically or medically compatible with this study.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent participation in a clinical study with active treatment
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Within the last 90 days before screening (Visit 1), have participated in a clinical study and received active treatment or unknown if they received active treatment.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Prior participation in eloralintide study
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have previously completed or withdrawn from this study or any other study investigating eloralintide after receiving at least 1 dose of intervention.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent oral contrast or radionuclide procedure before DXA
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have had a procedure (within 10 days of screening [Visit 2]) where oral contrast or radionuclides were administered, for example, CT with contrast or nuclear medicine.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Pregnancy, breastfeeding, or intention to conceive
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are pregnant, intending to breastfeed, or intending to conceive.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Investigator site personnel or immediate family
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are investigator site personnel directly affiliated with this study and/or their immediate family. Immediate family is defined as a spouse, legal partner, parent, child, or sibling, whether biological or legally adopted.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Any condition jeopardizing participant safety
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have any condition, unwillingness, or inability, not covered by any of the other exclusion criteria, which in the investigator's opinion might jeopardize the participant's safety, for example, hypersensitivity or contraindication.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Medical condition contraindicated for trial participation
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have any medical condition that, in the opinion of the investigator, would be a contraindication to participation in the trial.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Lilly employees or employees of third parties involved in the study
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Are Lilly employees or are employees of any third party involved in the study who require exclusion of their employees.

eligibilityCriteria.name: Prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity
Prior or planned endoscopic/device-based therapy for obesity
Obesity induced by endocrinologic disorders or monogenetic/syndromic forms
Recent use of prohibited antihyperglycemic medications
Current treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema
NYHA Class IV congestive heart failure
Hepatic conditions or abnormal liver laboratory values
Family or personal history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN2
History of active or untreated malignancy
Hematological condition interfering with HbA1c measurement
Significant active or unstable major depressive or psychiatric disorder
Transplanted organ or awaiting organ transplant
Prohibited glucose-lowering medications or insulin history
Hypersensitivity to amylin or study product
Recent use of weight reduction medications or remedies
Medications that may cause significant weight gain
Currently enrolled in another clinical study
Recent participation in a clinical study with active treatment
Recent oral contrast or radionuclide procedure before DXA
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, or intention to conceive
Investigator site personnel or immediate family
Medical condition contraindicated for trial participation
Lilly employees or employees of third parties involved in the study

studyInterventions.description: Matching placebo administered SC QW for 64 weeks

studyInterventions.name: Oral antihyperglycemic medications (AHMs)
studyInterventions.description: Stable background treatment for T2D consisting of diet/exercise alone or up to 3 oral AHMs (excluding incretins, except DPP-4i are allowed) for at least 90 days prior to screening; participants must remain on stable treatment during the study

studyInterventions.name: Lifestyle counseling (healthy nutrition and physical activity)
studyInterventions.description: All participants receive lifestyle-modification counseling consistent with current guidelines for weight management and diabetes education throughout the study, including consultation with a dietitian or equivalent

studyInterventions.name: Insulin (rescue therapy)
studyInterventions.description: Urgent use of short-term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting may be used as rescue therapy for severe, persistent hyperglycemia; study intervention must be temporarily interrupted when insulin is used as short-term rescue therapy; insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited

studyInterventions.name: New antihyperglycemic medications
studyInterventions.description: Initiation of new antihyperglycemic medications is permitted per protocol Section 6.9.1 for glycemic management; insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited
